about: What the API and key inventory (sca/flutter/inventory.py) should list for samples/flutter_api_probe and the packages built from it (python tools/build_flutter_apks.py --app flutter_api_probe --modes release,obfuscated,debug). Each item names how it is matched in facts['apis'] and the scans that should list it (all four when 'modes' is missing). The Stripe and Firebase keys are written in parts in the Dart source and joined by the compiler, so only the compiled code (release, obfuscated) holds them whole; the Maps key is joined by Gradle into the built manifest.

items.what: Stripe secret key (joined by the compiler)
Google Maps key of the manifest (joined by Gradle)
Firebase API key, public by design (joined by the compiler)
User name and password in an address
Telegram bot token in an address (joined by the compiler)
Empty API-key query template retained with a location, without a literal-secret alert
Runtime token query template retained with a location, without a literal-secret alert
Firebase project ID, database and storage bucket
HTTP, WebSocket and GraphQL calls with their targets (10 or more)
